mesh.title: Simulated mesh relay
mesh.explainer: Real phone-to-phone relaying needs native Bluetooth mesh, which browsers cannot do. This is an honest simulation of that hop sequence, coordinated through the platform so the dashboard animates the same relay. Real BLE mesh is our documented Phase 2.
mesh.no_peers: No peers yet — open this app in another tab or device to add one.
mesh.transport_local: Coordinated locally (no backend) — relays between tabs on this machine
mesh.relay_started: {{from}} has no signal — searching for a peer…
mesh.relay_delivered: Delivered by {{node}} to the control room
mesh.relay_waiting: Waiting for a peer with signal…
mesh.demo_hint: Files a test report from this device while it has no signal, and relays it to a peer that does.
mesh.out_of_range: Out of radio range — cannot hear this device
mesh.topology: Nodes hear only their immediate neighbours (A↔B↔C), so a report must hop along the chain.
